title: From Ten Scores to One Decision
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Open Educational Resources
description: A funnel that narrows ten metric scores to two subtotals, a total out of 100, a score band, and one decision, with the floor shown as a gate.

educational.topic: How ten metric scores combine into subtotals, a total, a band, and a decision
learningObjectives: The learner will trace ten metric scores through subtotals, a total, a band, and a decision, and explain why the floor can override a high total.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Explore a reference picture, then quiz on the same picture
keyQuestions: What does each layer keep, and what does it lose?
Which metric is below the floor?
commonMisconceptions: A total of 75 or more always means Adopt
The total is the most informative number in a report
assessmentOpportunities: What band is a total of 65?
A resource totals 85. Is it always Adopt?

controls.name: Explore and Quiz buttons
controls.description: switch between exploring the poster and answering quiz questions.

controls.name: Numbered markers
controls.description: hover or press to read about that part of the poster. In quiz mode a press is your answer.

controls.name: Try Again
controls.description: repeats the quiz after the last question.
